script: Decision: requires further review. The claimant reports theft from a locked library locker and a police report, but cannot confirm the visible entry damage required by CA-HO4-THEFT. Forcible entry and applicability of the endorsement’s off-premises exclusion remain unresolved. Next action: Obtain the police report and available locker inspection records or photographs, and review the endorsement’s specific off-premises exclusion before deciding coverage.
